name: new_bank_v1_zenodo_replacement_file_level_v1
scope: Coarse full-recording intent-label retrieval, not interval/repetition recognition or realtime performance
window_selection: up to 100 deterministic evenly spaced disjoint complete 200-sample windows across the entire native recording
corrupt_record_policy: Reject whole recording if any row is not eight finite numeric values. Do not delete rows or impute. For each subject/target position, evaluate only movement codes with valid gallery and target whole recordings; apply the same matched set to every arm.
insufficient_class_policy: A subject with fewer than two valid P1 movement recordings is excluded from both target positions. A subject-position pair with fewer than two matched valid classes is excluded from that position. Record all exclusions and included-subject counts before model scores; never fill missing classes from partial recordings.
file_descriptor: mean feature vector over selected windows, including any rest intervals because no native interval labels exist
retrieval: subject-specific gallery P1 source-only StandardScaler, nearest Euclidean gallery descriptor; one gallery recording per movement
selection_rule: Do not alter QC, windows, features, arm combinations or metric after seeing P2 or P3 outcomes. Report P2-preferred arm on P3 and all arms descriptively.
limitations: This benchmark cannot prove gesture timing, trial-level classification, wearer shift isolated from position, IMU effects, or the user's own-device performance.
